# Plarix

> Plarix builds operational AI for home services companies. We take over the back
> office processes every job leaves behind, running them inside the systems a shop
> already uses. No data migration, no new software to learn, no long contract.

## What we run
- Warranty and rebate recovery
- Invoice and job reconciliation
- Purchasing and vendor credits
- Permits, licensing and compliance
- Technician pay and commissions
- Memberships and service agreements

## How we work
1. Count. We read the shop's real data and report what is actually sitting there,
   before anything is sold. Free. If we find nothing, we say so.
2. Build. We build the narrow process that handles exactly what we found, live in
   weeks, running against existing systems.
3. Prove. One page a month: what ran, what it recovered, what it saved.
